title: Rate-Lock Exclusion from Grant-Payable Closing Costs, by Lock Term
content:
The rate-lock exclusion of the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant follows the term of the Rate Lock Commitment on the loan file, because a borrower who chose a short lock bears the cost of extending or repricing it. It is measured on the borrower-borne extension, relock and float-down costs booked on that lock, less any of those costs Larkspur later waived, as the lock's pricing entries record them.

| Rate lock product on the file | Rate-lock exclusion |
|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock, Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock or Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | the whole of the borrower-borne extension, relock and float-down costs booked on that lock, less any of those costs Larkspur later waived |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock or Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | half (50 percent) of that amount, rounded to the cent |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock or Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | nothing |

**Clause.** Under a 15-Day, 30-Day or 45-Day Rate Lock the whole of the borrower-borne extension, relock and float-down costs booked on that lock, less any of those costs Larkspur later waived, is excluded; under a 60-Day or 90-Day Rate Lock half of that amount, rounded to the cent, is excluded; under a 120-Day Extended or 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock nothing is excluded.

**Where the exclusion acts.** In finding the grant's unpaid closing costs, the rate-lock exclusion is subtracted from the payable closing costs together with the concessions, the charges paid before closing and the closing-cost entries already booked, before the floor at zero.

### Worked example (hypothetical lock entries)

A lock carries a borrower-borne extension cost of 375.00, a borrower-borne relock fee of 450.00 and a borrower-borne float-down fee of 200.00, and Larkspur later waived 100.00 of those costs: 925.00 in all.

| Lock product | Exclusion |
|---|---|
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 925.00 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 462.50 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 0.00 |

Costs on the lock that Larkspur bears are not borrower-borne and are not in the measure.
